#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

int readInt() {
    int x; cin >> x; return x;
}
string readString() {
    string s; cin >> s; return s;
}

struct Edge {
    int from, to, capacity, flow;
};

vector<Edge> edges;
vector<int> graph[100000];
int dist1[31][31], dist2[31][31];
int dx[] = {0, 0, -1, 1};
int dy[] = {1, -1, 0, 0};
int n, t;
string a[30], b[30];
int whereX, whereY;
int source, sink;
int di[100000], ptr[100000], q[100000];

void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
    edges.push_back({u, v, cap, 0});
    graph[u].push_back((int)edges.size() - 1);
    edges.push_back({v, u, 0, 0});
    graph[v].push_back((int)edges.size() - 1);
}

bool isValid(int x, int y) {
    return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n;
}

void BFS1(int x = 0, int y = 0) {
    queue<pair<int,int>> q;
    q.push({x, y});
    for (int i = 0; i <= 20; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j <= 20; ++j)
            dist1[i][j] = 1e9;
    dist1[x][y] = 0;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        auto [cx, cy] = q.front(); q.pop();
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
            int nx = cx + dx[i], ny = cy + dy[i];
            if (isValid(nx, ny) && dist1[nx][ny] >= 1e9 && b[nx][ny] != 'Y') {
                dist1[nx][ny] = dist1[cx][cy] + 1;
                q.push({nx, ny});
            }
        }
    }
}

bool bfs() {
    memset(di, -1, sizeof(di));
    int head = 0, tail = 0;
    q[tail++] = source;
    di[source] = 0;
    while (head < tail && di[sink] == -1) {
        int v = q[head++];
        for (int id : graph[v]) {
            int to = edges[id].to;
            if (di[to] == -1 && edges[id].flow < edges[id].capacity) {
                di[to] = di[v] + 1;
                q[tail++] = to;
            }
        }
    }
    return di[sink] != -1;
}

int dfs(int v, int flow) {
    if (flow == 0) return 0;
    if (v == sink) return flow;
    for (int &i = ptr[v]; i < (int)graph[v].size(); ++i) {
        int id = graph[v][i];
        int to = edges[id].to;
        if (di[to] != di[v] + 1) continue;
        int pushed = dfs(to, min(flow, edges[id].capacity - edges[id].flow));
        if (pushed > 0) {
            edges[id].flow += pushed;
            edges[id ^ 1].flow -= pushed;
            return pushed;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

int maxFlow() {
    int totalFlow = 0;
    while (bfs()) {
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)edges.size(); ++i)
            ptr[i] = 0;
        while (int pushed = dfs(source, 1e9))
            totalFlow += pushed;
    }
    return totalFlow;
}

    q.push({x, y});
    for (int i = 0; i <= 20; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j <= 20; ++j)
            dist2[i][j] = 1e9;

                dist2[nx][ny] = dist2[cx][cy] + 1;

            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        b[i] = readString();
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (b[i][j] == 'Z') {
                b[i][j] = 'Y'; a[i][j] = 'Y';
                whereX = i; whereY = j;
            }
        }
    }
    BFS1();
    source = 0; sink = 2 * n * n + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (a[i][j] == 'Y') continue;
            int inNode = i * n + j + 1;

                    addEdge(inNode, n * n + ptx * n + pty + 1, a[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout << maxFlow() << endl;
    return 0;
}

int sendFlow(int v, int flow) {
    if (v==t_) return flow;
    for (int &i=ptr[v]; i<(int)g[v].size(); ++i) {
        int id=g[v][i];
        int to=edges[id].to;
        if (level[to]!=level[v]+1 || edges[id].flow>=edges[id].cap) continue;
        int pushed=sendFlow(to, min(flow, edges[id].cap - edges[id].flow));
        if (pushed>0) {
            edges[id].flow+=pushed;
            edges[id^1].flow-=pushed;
            return pushed;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
